tei:div.tei:p: This prayer for the success of the Israeli Defense Forces and the safety of all the inhabitants of the Land of Israel offered by the Masorti Movement in Israel during the November 12th, 2019 Tel Aviv rocket strike. It was first published on the website of the Masorti Movement without a translation. The prayer is based upon a prayer previously prepared by Rabbi Simcha Roth and Rabbi Michael Graetz. The English translation presented here was prepared by Aharon Varady and contributors to the Open Siddur Project, with corrections by Shoshana Michael Zucker.
